Entry Noble Education The education of noble children includes etiquette, genealogy, riding, reading and writing, politics and managing territory. Parents hope that they will learn to bear the family name, and their children will also learn that power does not rely solely on swords; the purpose of education is often to prevent heirs from having too much power like ordinary people. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.

Entry Noble Education The education of noble children includes etiquette, genealogy, riding, reading and writing, politics and managing territory. Parents hope that they will learn to bear the family name, and their children will also learn that power does not rely solely on swords; the purpose of education is often to prevent heirs from having too much power like ordinary people. They may not necessarily understand ledgers, but they know the true weight of a bag of salt and a nail on the road.
